supplements.title: Integrated transcriptomic analysis reveals a lncRNA-miRNA-TF-mRNA regulatory network underlying quercetin's anti-hepatocellular carcinoma effects.
supplements.summary: Quercetin fights hepatocellular carcinoma by activating a regulatory network that silences cancer-promoting genes.

supplements.title: Identifying PLAU as a shared pathogenic gene in type 2 diabetes and bladder urothelial carcinoma through integrated transcriptomic analysis and machine learning for diagnostic and therapeutic value.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified PLAU as a shared gene in type 2 diabetes and bladder cancer, finding that targeting it with EGCG compound may slow tumor growth.

supplements.title: Evaluation of Umbelliferone Neuroprotective Effects Against Acrylamide-Induced Oxidative Stress, In Vivo and In Silico Study.
supplements.summary: Umbelliferone, a natural plant compound, protected mouse brains and livers from cancer-causing acrylamide toxicity through antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.

supplements.title: Fetal growth is driven by a bimodal fetal beta cell response and reshaped by a ketogenic diet in a mouse model of maternal diabetes.
supplements.summary: A ketogenic diet in pregnant mice with diabetes may prevent abnormal fetal growth by altering fetal insulin response.

supplements.title: Comprehensive metabolomic profiling of Egyptian Salvia species reveals promising leads for chemopreventive and anti-inflammatory drug development: In vitro and In silico study.
supplements.summary: Egyptian Salvia multicaulis plant extract shows promise for preventing cancer and reducing inflammation through activation of protective proteins.

supplements.title: Ferrostatin-1 and hinokitiol supplementation enhance human hematopoietic stem cell expansion in a chemically defined medium.
supplements.summary: Two supplements—ferrostatin-1 and hinokitiol—significantly improve expansion of blood-forming stem cells by reducing oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Sustainable green synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles for antimicrobial and anticancer applications.
supplements.summary: Researchers created zinc oxide nanoparticles using cucumber seed extract, showing strong anticancer effects against breast cancer cells and antibacterial activity.

supplements.title: Intermittent fasting synergizes with GCN5 inhibition to suppress RBM5-AS1/GCN5/PGC-1α-driven Warburg metabolism in ovarian cancer.
supplements.summary: Combining intermittent fasting with a GCN5 inhibitor effectively suppresses ovarian cancer growth by restoring normal metabolism.

supplements.title: Anti-Inflammatory and Selective Anticancer Activities of Supernatants from Lactiplantibacillus plantarum S61 Fermented on Glucose and Xylooligosaccharides.
supplements.summary: Fermented bacterial supernatants selectively kill breast cancer cells while sparing healthy cells, with strong anti-inflammatory effects.

supplements.title: Ameliorative effect of Nano berberine in bleomycin- induced lung fibrosis in male rats.
supplements.summary: Nano-formulated berberine reduced lung fibrosis in rats by decreasing inflammation and collagen buildup.

supplements.title: Integrin αvβ3-Targeted SLNs for Co-Delivery of Paclitaxel and Quercetin in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed targeted nanoparticles delivering two drugs together to triple-negative breast cancer, significantly reducing tumor growth in mice without toxicity.

supplements.title: The neuroprotective and therapeutic potential of resveratrol for traumatic spinal cord injuries: a systematic review.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol, a plant compound, shows promise in protecting nerve cells and improving motor function recovery in traumatic spinal cord injuries.

supplements.title: Dietary Guinea hen weed (Petiveria alliacea) leaf meal improves growth performance, redox balance and inflammatory indices in rabbits raised under hot-humid tropical conditions.
supplements.summary: Guinea hen weed leaf meal in rabbit feed improves growth and reduces oxidative stress and inflammation in hot tropical conditions.

supplements.title: Medium-Chain Fatty Acid-Enabled Nanostructured Lipid Carriers for Improved β-carotene Biopharmaceutical Properties and Antioxidant Efficacy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle delivery system using medium-chain fatty acids to significantly improve beta-carotene absorption and antioxidant effectiveness.

supplements.title: Betaine induces ferroptotic stress by enhancing KEAP1-mediated NRF2 degradation in breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Betaine kills breast cancer cells by triggering a process that breaks down a protective protein, making cells vulnerable to iron-driven death.

off_label.title: Single-nucleus interrogation of primate small intestinal aging reveals NCoR1 decline as a conserved feature that is reversed by metformin.
off_label.summary: Metformin reverses age-related intestinal decline by restoring NCoR1 protein levels in primates and human cells.

off_label.title: The O‑GlcNAcase inhibition by Thiamet G disrupts the AngioMatrix signature of the Glioblastoma secretome in silico and impairs its angiogenic capacity in vitro.
off_label.summary: Thiamet G inhibitor reduces glioblastoma's ability to promote blood vessel formation, a potential new treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Fluoxetine-associated adverse event signals with a focus on seizure: A study based on the FAERS database, network pharmacology, and molecular docking.
off_label.summary: Fluoxetine, an antidepressant, shows increased seizure risk as a side effect based on FDA safety reports and molecular analysis.

off_label.title: Gut microbial metabolism of Flutamide attenuates its therapeutic efficacy against prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: Gut bacteria break down the prostate cancer drug Flutamide into inactive forms, reducing its effectiveness and suggesting personalized treatment approaches.

off_label.title: The metabolic plasticity of cancer stem cells: bidirectional crosstalk with organ-resident cells.
off_label.summary: Cancer stem cells adapt their metabolism through interactions with surrounding tissue cells, which could be targeted to overcome treatment resistance.

off_label.title: Repurposing ALK Inhibitors as Influenza and Corona Virus Antivirals Targeting Lymphocyte Tyrosine Kinase (LTK).
off_label.summary: Existing cancer drugs that inhibit ALK show promise as antivirals against influenza and COVID-19 by targeting a host cell protein viruses need.

off_label.title: Orbital Myiasis Secondary to Neglected Medial Canthal Basal Cell Carcinoma Caused by Chrysomya bezziana.
off_label.summary: Untreated basal cell carcinoma of the eye allowed fly larvae to infest the orbit, successfully treated with larvae removal, antibiotics, and ivermectin.

off_label.title: Attenuation of ABCG2-dependent drug efflux by befotertinib restores chemosensitivity in multidrug-resistant non-small cell lung cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Befotertinib, an EGFR inhibitor, restores chemotherapy effectiveness in drug-resistant lung cancer by blocking a protein that pumps drugs out of tumor cells.

off_label.title: DPP-4 inhibitor alleviates gut-brain axis pathology in Parkinson's disease.
off_label.summary: DPP-4 inhibitor drugs reduce Parkinson's disease symptoms by blocking harmful protein transmission from the gut to the brain.

off_label.title: Pulmonary Hydatid Cyst Rupture Associated With Albendazole Commencement: Case Report and Literature Review.
off_label.summary: Albendazole treatment for pulmonary hydatid cysts may cause dangerous rupture within three weeks of starting therapy.

off_label.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Primary Prevention of Cancer Therapy-Related Cardiac Dysfunction.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 drugs reduced heart damage risk by half in cancer patients receiving toxic chemotherapy, across multiple cancer types.

off_label.title: Targeting the Calcineurin Homologous Protein 1 (CHP1)-Transmembrane Protein 87A (TMEM87A) mechanosensing complex: a druggable vulnerability in metastatic ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified a protein complex in ovarian cancer that enables metastasis, and sodium gluconate treatment successfully reduced tumor spread in mice.

off_label.title: An Agentic Platform for Drug Repurposing Unified across Molecular, Phenotypic, and Clinical Scales.
off_label.summary: LinkD, a new AI platform, identifies existing drugs that work against cancer by analyzing molecular, cellular, and patient data together.

off_label.title: CA7 overexpression enhances the anti-tumor effects of propofol in colorectal cancer via JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
off_label.summary: CA7 protein boosts propofol's cancer-fighting effects in colorectal cancer by blocking a specific growth pathway.

off_label.title: Enhancing Continence Recovery After Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy: A Novel Combined Approach Using Testosterone Therapy and Magnetic Stimulation.
off_label.summary: Testosterone therapy combined with magnetic stimulation helps prostate cancer patients recover bladder control after robotic surgery.

biomarkers.title: A mixed-method study of identifying symptom clusters in adult patients with advanced cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified groups of symptoms that commonly occur together in adults with advanced cancer using combined research methods.

biomarkers.title: CXCL13-expressing CD4+ T cells coordinate the lymphocytes triad to promote the anti-tumor immunity in NSCLC.
biomarkers.summary: A specific CD4+ T cell subset recruits B cells to form a three-cell immune cluster that enhances anti-tumor responses in lung cancer.

biomarkers.title: Differentiating benign from malignant pulmonary nodules in the context of bronchiectasis: a retrospective study.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified risk factors to help doctors distinguish cancerous from non-cancerous lung nodules in bronchiectasis patients.

biomarkers.title: Stattic administration plays a protective role in a lipopolysaccharide-induced acute lung injury cell model.
biomarkers.summary: Stattic, a Stat3 inhibitor, protects lung cells from inflammation and damage induced by bacterial toxins.

biomarkers.title: Postoperative stimulated thyroglobulin and the ps-tg/TSH ratio enhance the 2025 ATA risk stratification for predicting radioiodine response in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Postoperative thyroglobulin levels improve prediction of treatment success in papillary thyroid cancer when added to standard risk assessment guidelines.

biomarkers.title: Leveraging cDC1 biology and function for enhanced immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Enhancing immune cells called cDC1s improves cancer immunotherapy by boosting tumor-fighting T cell responses.

biomarkers.title: Transcriptomic analysis identifies novel ferroptosis-related biomarkers and therapeutic targets in pulmonary arterial hypertension.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified new genes linked to ferroptosis that could lead to treatments for pulmonary arterial hypertension.

biomarkers.title: Efficient NK cell transduction with VSV-G-pseudotyped lentiviral vectors.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers optimized lentiviral vector methods to efficiently modify NK immune cells for cancer therapy, achieving 80% transduction rates.

biomarkers.title: Efficient, fratricide free non-viral engineering of CD70-targeted CAR NK cells for hematologic and solid tumor immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers engineered NK cells to target CD70 cancer cells using non-viral methods, improving treatment effectiveness against AML and kidney cancer.

biomarkers.title: A new fully closed automated banking process for healthy autologous cells to standardize the starting material for CAR T manufacturing.
biomarkers.summary: A new automated system banks healthy donor cells to produce standardized, high-quality CAR T cells for cancer immunotherapy with improved efficiency and lower costs.

biomarkers.title: A single-cell multi-omics assay for simultaneous measurement of vector copy number and protein expression in CAR T cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a single-cell test to measure gene copies and protein levels in CAR T cancer cells, revealing differences between cell types.

biomarkers.title: Epigenetic editing balances TCR suppression and persistence in CAR T cells.
biomarkers.summary: Epigenetic editing safely silences the T cell receptor in CAR T cells without permanent DNA changes, reducing graft-versus-host disease risk while improving cell persistence.

biomarkers.title: IL-12-engineered human PSMA-CAR T cells for the treatment of advanced prostate cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers engineered CAR T cells targeting prostate cancer to be safer and more effective by adding IL-12 to boost immune response.

biomarkers.title: Development of bicistronic plasmids and fusion proteins for clinical translation of tumor immune reprogramming.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created a simplified plasmid system to deliver cancer-fighting immune proteins more efficiently for clinical use in melanoma treatment.

biomarkers.title: Multi-omic profiling reveals SMAD4 drives linoleic acid-arachidonic acid metabolism to mediate PDAC radiosensitivity via the SLC27A3/FADS2 axis.
biomarkers.summary: SMAD4 protein controls fat metabolism in pancreatic cancer, making tumors more responsive to radiation therapy.

trials.title: The longitudinal effects of faith and meaning on quality of life in US women with breast cancer undergoing chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Strong faith and sense of meaning improve quality of life for breast cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

trials.title: Effect of yoga on musculoskeletal complaints in women during endocrine treatment for breast cancer: protocol of the randomised controlled COBRA trial.
trials.summary: A study tests whether yoga reduces muscle and joint pain in women taking long-term breast cancer medications.

trials.title: Feasibility and Efficacy of Reiki Versus Massage for Cancer-Related Fatigue in Patients With Breast and Prostate Cancer Receiving Hormone Therapy.
trials.summary: Reiki and massage therapy may reduce fatigue in breast and prostate cancer patients receiving hormone treatment.

trials.title: Development of a pandemic H5N1 influenza vaccine using MDCK suspension cells: A scalable and efficient production platform.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a fast, scalable method to produce H5N1 flu vaccines using cell cultures instead of eggs, achieving high vaccine quality in large quantities.

trials.title: A phase 1 clinical trial of a multi-antigen SARS-CoV DNA vaccine as a booster after dose three spike-based mRNA vaccinations.
trials.summary: A DNA booster vaccine safely increased antibody responses against COVID-19 variants in people previously vaccinated with mRNA vaccines.

trials.title: Development of bicistronic plasmids and fusion proteins for clinical translation of tumor immune reprogramming.
trials.summary: Researchers created a simplified plasmid system to deliver cancer-fighting immune proteins more efficiently for clinical use in melanoma treatment.

trials.title: Targeting BCL-2 and PI3K signaling pathways enhances cytotoxicity of gemtuzumab ozogamicin against acute myeloid leukemia cells.
trials.summary: Blocking BCL-2 and PI3K proteins alongside gemtuzumab ozogamicin significantly improves treatment effectiveness against resistant acute myeloid leukemia cells.
